value: **Computational & Agent-Based Modeling**: Engages students in constructing, programming, or debugging computational and agent-based simulation models to explore dynamic scientific or social phenomena. Evidence: "In a week-long science unit using the Bifocal Modeling approach, students perform hands-on experiments, design models and finally interact and compare real data with computational models."
